errors.description: slot_sample_q is a multi-bit value produced in tdm_clk and sampled directly in audio_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
slot_valid_pulse_q is a one-cycle tdm_clk pulse consumed directly in audio_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
slot_valid_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample audio_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in audio_event_o.
slot_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector slot_mode_q before decoding in audio_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
tdm_rst_n is used as data inside audio_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
bus_snapshot_q combines tdm_clk payload state with audio_clk status state in bus_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
